v03 results and remaining review questions

  • The measured height jump is corrected. All three alpha≥128 body heights are625px. Recovery now stays standing; final settlement still reuses the exact original idle source. This does not prove identical anatomy or smooth motion.
  • Individual foot drift remains. Measured sole-center separation is229px in idle and252px in attack/recovery. After midpoint alignment at36px, each foot moves outward by0.6624px (v02 was about1.02px). At32px the shift is0.5888px per foot. The guides show the fixed midpoint and idle sole-center x positions.
  • Shell separation still needs actual-size review. The recovery shell is now above the feet, but its contour still touches/overlaps the brown tail in the full-size source. Check the peach shell against paw, apron and tail at32/36px. Shell and body remain baked together; there is no independent shell layer.
  • Most interior pixels use alpha253, approximately0.78% transparency. Another15,568 pixels have alpha1–7. Their visible impact and safe frame windows remain review questions.
  • Display windows are measured alpha≥8 bounds with4px padding. Faint outlying pixels beyond those windows are not shown in playback. This is runtime clipping, not image cleanup; the full raw strip is embedded below.
